response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate, AVG(rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005 GROUP BY orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per_order) SELECT p.orderslink, p.avg_total_rebate, p.avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio / NULLIF(o.mean_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A zero fee rate gives a missing ratio, and a zero overall mean gives a missing relative ratio because division by zero is undefined.
